posts.name: Nagnazul
posts.cooked:
In a 2-player game, let's say both players are doing growth and pick a growth option that involves gaining a power. Is it within the rules for player 1 to look at 4 minor powers, then player 2 to look at the next 4 minor powers before player 1 makes a choice? Having that extra information can be helpful for making a decision, but I'd like to know if that's within the rules. Wouldn't want to cheat while playing at the highest difficulties :)

Thanks!

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: I do that all the time so I certainly hope it's okay ;). And all too often I compare my four cards to those of the other person and grumble about how we should've drawn our four cards the other way around so that we each actually got options that involve our Elements and stuff :P. But yeah, as far as I'm aware there's no reason to wait for another player to pick their card before you draw four for yourself to choose from. And obviously you can only choose a card from the four you've drawn - you can't look at someone else's (or have them look at yours) and pick one of those ;).
